profile.headline: Software Developer and Production Support at Empower Retirement
profile.summary: I’m a driven and organized IT professional that enjoys the puzzles and problem-solving needs of the IT industry. I have a creative mind that thinks outside the box and love the logic challenges of the software development field, but also enjoy and thrive in project-oriented and managerial focused roles in my field. My current role has me functioning as a software developer and sometimes as a business analyst for requirements gathering and documentation creation but, in the past, I’ve also operated as a technical lead and project lead on a growing software development team in the aerospace engineering industry and I do plan to apply those skills in the retirement services industry down the road.

positions.title: Software Developer and Production Support
positions.description:
Utilizing the Biznuvo platform; develop business rules, services, applications and data transformations for data transition process of MassMutual Retirement Services data as it transitions into Empower's systems as part of the acquisition of MassMutual's Retirement Services division by Empower. 

A highlight project utilizes Biznuvo and MySQL to preprocess all payroll files being migrated from MassMutual to Empower. The application identifies the file type, and pipes it through the appropriate mapping path to output an Empower compatible text file which is then consumed into Empower’s data warehouse. 

Collaborate with neighboring teams to align project requirements and business teams to develop requirements for both business and technical sides of the assigned projects. 

Editing MySQL queries used for interfacing Biznuvo applications and services with MySQL databases for storage, reporting, and population of data sets. 

Functioning as an Agile developer maintaining stories, tasks and decision trees, in Jira and Confluence. Participate in daily standing meetings with Scrum masters and Product owners as well as Biznuvo consulting team. 

Assist in platform regression testing when patches and updates come out for the Biznuvo platform itself as well as in other administration-based production support activities including but not limited to user permissions management, back-end configuration file updates via AWS/Linux command line and assisting other team members in troubleshooting via system log files.

positions.title: Business Services Developer
positions.description:
Utilizing the Biznuvo platform, develop business rules for completing calculations of loan data (ie. loan payoffs, borrowing amounts, modeling information, etc) as well as comparatives on competing funds. 

Functioned as a SAFe Agile developer maintaining stories, tasks and decision trees, in Jira and Confluence. Had daily standing meetings with Scrum master and Product owner as well as participating in quarterly program increment planning sessions both in person and digitally during COVID lock-down. 

Collaborated with neighboring teams to align project requirements. 

Maintained a comprehensive platform level bug tracker to aide our platform supplier in enhancing our development software. This includes a running list of open bugs and enhancement suggestions from the MassMutual team and hosting biweekly meetings, with the Supplier's assigned team to coordinate patch releases and minimize the impact of open items on existing work as well as other teams.

positions.title: Database and Software Management Technical Manager
positions.description: Customize and build databases, SharePoint sites and .net applications while managing a team of developers that do the same. Also responsible for interfacing with clients and with corporate IT teams of client company. Utilized as primary technical adviser working with the account managers to maximize throughput for new work and expansions on existing contracts. Also directly responsible for the staffing and training of new developers.

positions.title: Database and Software Management Team Lead
positions.description: I also manage an internal team of 10 members who's tasks vary between creating and managing access databases to VB.net applications and MS SharePoint development. I also utilize my own web development background to aid in SharePoint development as well as hosting and administering our center's intranet information SharePoint site for mass announcement flow down project coordination tools, Ace 6S Assessments, and personnel directory.

positions.title: Ultrasonic Inspector
positions.description: Performed hand scan (A and B) ultrasonic inspections on development and  in circulation parts for aircraft, oil drilling equipment, and generators.

positions.title: Electronics Service Technician/Quality Service Inspector
positions.description: Repair customer PDA's, bar-coding equipment and printers. Maintain a running database of repair records. Answered customer questions via email and in the form of tech support phone calls. Trained new employees in repair and quality inspection techniques.
